parameter.label: P_USOPROD : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT VALOR AS VALUE, OPCAO AS LABEL FROM TDDOPC WHERE NUCAMPO = 613

simple-value.value-expression: ESTOQUE SEM MOVIMENTO

grid.expression: WITH MovAgg AS ( SELECT I.CODPROD, I.CODLOCALORIG AS CODLOCAL, MAX(C.DTNEG) AS MOVIMENTACAO FROM TGFITE I INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA GROUP BY I.CODPROD, I.CODLOCALORIG ), MovAfter AS ( SELECT DISTINCT I.CODPROD, I.CODLOCALORIG AS CODLOCAL FROM TGFITE I INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA WHERE TRUNC(C.DTNEG) > :P_DTCORTE ) SELECT V.CODPROD, V.DESCRPROD, V.CODVOL, V.CODLOCAL, SUM(V.ESTOQUE) AS ESTOQUE, SUM(V.RESERVADO) AS RESERVADO, V.LOCALIZACAO, MAX(V.MOVIMENTACAO) AS MOVIMENTACAO, CASE WHEN MAX(V.MOVIMENTACAO) IS NULL OR MAX(V.MOVIMENTACAO) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -36) THEN '#FF6666' WHEN MAX(V.MOVIMENTACAO) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -24) THEN '#FF9999' WHEN MAX(V.MOVIMENTACAO) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -12) THEN '#FFCCCC' ELSE NULL END AS bkcolor, V.OPCAO FROM ( SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, EST.CODLOCAL, EST.ESTOQUE, EST.RESERVADO, NVL(PRO.LOCALIZACAO,'SEM LOC') AS LOCALIZACAO, MA.MOVIMENTACAO, OPC.OPCAO FROM TGFPRO PRO INNER JOIN TGFEST EST ON PRO.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD LEFT JOIN MovAgg MA ON MA.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND MA.CODLOCAL = EST.CODLOCAL LEFT JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON PRO.USOPROD = OPC.VALOR AND OPC.NUCAMPO = 613 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MovAfter MX WHERE MX.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND MX.CODLOCAL = EST.CODLOCAL ) AND (:P_CODLOCAL IS NULL OR EST.CODLOCAL = :P_CODLOCAL) AND EST.CODEMP = 1 AND PRO.USOPROD IN :P_USOPROD UNION ALL SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, EST.CODLOCAL, EST.ESTOQUE, EST.RESERVADO, NVL(PRO.LOCALIZACAO,'SEM LOC') AS LOCALIZACAO, MA.MOVIMENTACAO, OPC.OPCAO FROM TGFPRO PRO INNER JOIN TGFEST EST ON PRO.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD LEFT JOIN MovAgg MA ON MA.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND MA.CODLOCAL = EST.CODLOCAL LEFT JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON PRO.USOPROD = OPC.VALOR AND OPC.NUCAMPO = 613 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MovAfter MX WHERE MX.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND MX.CODLOCAL = EST.CODLOCAL ) AND (:P_CODLOCAL IS NULL OR EST.CODLOCAL = :P_CODLOCAL) AND EST.CODEMP = 501 AND PRO.USOPROD IN :P_USOPROD ) V GROUP BY V.CODPROD, V.DESCRPROD, V.CODVOL, V.CODLOCAL, V.LOCALIZACAO, V.OPCAO HAVING (:P_VALIDEST <> 'S' OR SUM(V.ESTOQUE) > 0) ORDER BY V.CODPROD, V.CODLOCAL
